subject: Re: RFP - IAM deployment evidence and SCIM/SAML mapping for CinderPoint
messages:
From: Alex Beckett <alex.beckett@cinderpoint.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IAM deployment evidence + SCIM mapping for CinderPoint RFP

Jonas,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. As part of CinderPoint's enterprise RFP (attached in the portal), we need a short evidence pack and clarifications focused on Identity & Access Management. Can you provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (6/22)?

- A SCIM attribute mapping (CSV) showing attributes you expose and whether create/update/delta are supported.
- SAML metadata XML for your SP and notes on IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flows and single logout behavior.
- RBAC / admin controls: brief matrix showing tenant admins, delegated admin roles, and ability to limit admin scopes.
- Any deployment playbook or runbook that outlines a typical enterprise onboarding (timelines, handoffs, evidence artifacts).
- Pointer to SOC2 / security artifact references and a contact for a technical deep-dive.

We know this is a lot; if needed, provide initial artifacts and we can follow with a technical session.

Attachments: CinderPoint_RFP_SectionIII.pdf (portal reference)

Best,
Alex Beckett
Sr. Procurement Manager
CinderPoint


From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Beckett <alex.beckett@cinderpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM deployment evidence + SCIM mapping for CinderPoint RFP

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested. I’ve attached an initial SCIM attribute map (redwood_scim_map_v1.csv) and our SAML SP metadata (redwood_saml_metadata.xml) to get you started. A few quick notes upfront:

- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 with full create/update and incremental (delta) syncs; bulk operations are supported via our provisioning API (documented in the playbook). The CSV indicates canonical attribute names plus recommended mappings.
- SAML: We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO. SLO is supported for IdP-initiated flows; for SP-initiated flows we recommend IdP-initiated logout for reliability (details in metadata/notes).
- RBAC/admin controls: we have tenant admins, role templates, and delegated admin scopes. I’ve put a short matrix in access_admin_matrix.xlsx — it maps actions to permission tiers.
- Deployment playbook: attached is a lightweight playbook (deployment_playbook_v1.pdf) outlining the typical onboarding timeline (2–4 weeks for a standard enterprise integration), handoffs between your IdP team and our solutions engineering, and evidence we provide at each stage.

We can also schedule a 45-minute technical walkthrough next week if that helps. Marissa will lead the run-through and Kim can handle the provisioning and RBAC deep-dive.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_scim_map_v1.csv (SCIM attribute map, columns: scim_name, description, create, update, delta_supported), redwood_saml_metadata.xml (SP metadata), access_admin_matrix.xlsx, deployment_playbook_v1.pdf

Let me know what time works for you; we have availability Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Beckett <alex.beckett@cinderpoint.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cinderpoint.com
Date: 2027-06-20T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM deployment evidence + SCIM mapping for CinderPoint RFP

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. A few clarifications from our IdP and SSO team after reviewing the CSV and metadata:

1) For SCIM delta support, can you confirm how you surface deletes? Do you soft-delete with active=false or send explicit delete events? Also, what is your recommended poll interval for delta tokens?
2) On bulk provisioning: is there a transactional bulk endpoint (single call, multiple creates) or do you recommend batched calls? What is rate limiting behavior for provisioning APIs?
3) For delegated admin: can delegated admins be constrained by OU / tenant subset? We need to ensure least-privilege for our provisioning admins.
4) SAML: our security team asked whether you include NameID formats other than transient/email, and what claims/attributes you recommend for group membership sync when groups exceed 200 members.

Lastly, can you share a point of contact from your security/compliance team for SOC2 artifact questions? We may request encryption-at-rest details and data retention specifics.

If you can answer inline that would be great; otherwise the walkthrough next week will work.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Beckett <alex.beckett@cinderpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM deployment evidence + SCIM mapping for CinderPoint RFP

Alex —

Thanks — answers inline below, and I’ve summarized attachments and next steps at the bottom.

1) SCIM deletes: we surface deletes as explicit delete operations by default (HTTP DELETE) and also support soft-delete semantics if you prefer (active=false). For delta tokens we recommend poll intervals of 60–300s depending on your expected user churn; typical enterprise setups use 120s.

2) Bulk provisioning: we provide both: a transactional bulk endpoint (single POST with up to 1k members) and a batched endpoint if you need smaller batches. Rate limits are configurable for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted tenants default provisioning rate limits are 200 requests/minute with burst up to 1k. We can adjust limits on a per-contract basis.

3) Delegated admin scoping: yes — delegated admins can be scoped by OU/tenant subset, by application, and by permission template. The access_admin_matrix.xlsx shows the scoping flags and examples (e.g., provisioning_admin: scope=OU:engineering).

4) SAML NameID and groups: we support NameID formats: email, persistent, and transient. For large groups (200+ members) we recommend group membership via group IDs plus a separate group-sync endpoint (referenced in the playbook) rather than embedding oversized group lists in SAML assertions. We can also provide SCIM group syncing for membership fidelity.

Security/compliance contact: Kim Park (cc’d) will be your primary contact for SOC2 artefacts, encryption-at-rest details, and data retention policy. Kim — can you share the SOC2 report pointer and the KMS/HSM details?

Attachments included: redwood_scim_map_v1.csv (attribute mapping and delta flags), redwood_saml_metadata.xml (SP metadata + notes), access_admin_matrix.xlsx (permission matrix + scoping examples), deployment_playbook_v1.pdf (onboarding runbook).

Related links / references: HubSpot record HS-REC-59384, Shared playbook (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CinderPoint-Depl-Playbook).

Next steps:
- We’ll stand up a technical walkthrough on Tue 6/29 (Marissa to propose calendar invite).
- Kim will send SOC2 pointer and KMS details ahead of the call.
- If you want a sample SCIM delta run, we can provide a sandbox tenant for your IdP team.

Thanks — and happy to iterate on the CSV and matrix if your team prefers different attribute names.

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
